draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Mararikulam! This coastal village once handed V. S. Achuthanandan a shock defeat in 1996, in a seat seen as a Communist stronghold, and it cost him the Chief Minister's chair for another decade. It's also home to former international volleyball player K. Udayakumar.
draft.hungryLine: This is seafood and tender coconut country, and Cherthala town nearby has good budget spots for kuzhimanthi and Kerala snacks.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk through Mararikulam North, then head down to Marari Beach and over to Andhakaranazhy Beach for the evening.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Pick one of the quieter beaches, like Chethi, Thykkal or Ottamassery, where you'll barely see a crowd.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Coconut climbers here will pluck a tender coconut right in front of you and slice a hole in the top so you can drink it.

spots.name: Andhakaranazhy Beach

legends.title: The miraculous statue
legends.body: Thousands come to Thankey every year for a statue of the Passion of Our Lord that's believed to be miraculous. It's a pilgrimage of repentance and fresh starts.

legends.title: A Portuguese shrine
legends.body: The shrine at Arthunkal Basilica was made by the Portuguese and is still kept intact. It's one of six basilicas in Kerala for Catholics.

tips.title: Mind temple etiquette.
tips.body: The local temples, like Cherthala Karthyayani, are lovely to visit, but don't break any cultural practices.

tips.title: Stay for sunset.
tips.body: Andhakaranazhy Beach is the best place around Cherthala to watch the sun go down.

story.title: A seat is born
story.body: The Mararikulam Assembly constituency was created. It became one of seven seats in the Alleppey Lok Sabha constituency.

story.title: A veteran arrives
story.body: Communist leader V. S. Achuthanandan won Mararikulam and represented it until 1996.

story.title: The shock defeat
story.body: Achuthanandan lost here, in a seat seen as a Communist bastion, and missed out on becoming Chief Minister. He finally made it in 2006, elected from Malampuzha.

story.title: Lines redrawn
story.body: The constituency stopped existing after the 2008 delimitation. Mararikulam North carries on as a gram panchayat by the sea.

story.title: Beach hop
story.body: Grab a tender coconut, walk to Marari Beach and end the day at Andhakaranazhy. Tell me which beach you'd come back to.

food.name: Onion Restaurant
food.detail: Next to Cherthala KSRTC bus station · Kuzhimanthi, biriyani and fish curries, plus kilikkoodu and madakku from the bakery

food.name: Four Brothers
food.detail: Opposite Cherthala KSRTC bus station · A decent bakery for snacks and shakes
